text.description_html:
Fusion TR-G2-ORB, Rock Ridge Beveled Mount Hand Towel Ring

The Beveled Trim Sandcast Brass Hand Towel Ring is made with the attention to both quality and detail for which Fusion is known. the oil rubbed bronze finish is a perfect match to the distressed look of the piece, granting it an old world feel. This towel ring is easy to install and comes packaged with all the mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching: Fusion PH-G2 Rock Ridge Toilet Paper Holder, Fusion TB-G2 Rock Ridge Towel Bar, and Fusion RH-G2 Rock Ridge Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Rock Ridge Round Mount Hand Towel Ring:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Mount Diameter: 2-5/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
